# Upgrade notes

What each release asks of an operator, newest first. Before upgrading, read the notes of
every release after the one you run, up to the one you are moving to, then follow
[Upgrade](upgrade.md). A section that does not apply says "None."

<a id="0-2-0"></a>

## QuickBuilder 0.2.0

### Breaking changes

None.

### Manual steps

- A reverse proxy limits upload size: raise its limit for /api/v1/transfers/uploads to import large archives in the admin, or use the sites import command, which reads archives from disk and has no limit. (#20)
- Exports kept in the admin use media storage space for 7 days. (#20)
- Archives hold unpublished content and members' display names. Store them as you store database backups. (#20)
- Forward /_preview/ through reverse proxies that only pass selected paths (#22)
- Each open editor or item form sends a small request every 10 seconds; a reverse proxy that rate-limits the admin API must allow it. (#23)
- Reload admin tabs left open from before the upgrade to get presence and locks; until then their saves are still protected against overwriting. (#23)
- If you set Admin:PathPrefix (Admin__PathPrefix), remove it: the admin has always been served at /admin, the setting is now ignored, and startup logs a warning while it is set. (#50)

### Configuration

- Added [`SiteTransfer:MaxUploadSizeBytes`](reference/configuration.md#sitetransfer-maxuploadsizebytes) (#20)
- Added [`Trash:RetentionDays`](reference/configuration.md#trash-retentiondays) (#21)
- Added [`Preview:LinksValidFrom`](reference/configuration.md#preview-linksvalidfrom) (#22)
- Deprecated [`Admin:PathPrefix`](reference/configuration.md#admin-pathprefix) (#50)

### Background work after upgrading

- Hourly purge of trashed content past the retention period (#21)
- Hourly sweep of preview links that ended more than 30 days ago (#22)

### Caches

None.

## QuickBuilder 0.1.0

### Breaking changes

None.

### Manual steps

- Back up the database and the media volume before every upgrade: that backup is the only way back. (#19)
- Install from the docker-compose.yml attached to a release, which names an exact version; upgrade by changing that version. (#19)

### Configuration

None.

### Background work after upgrading

None.

### Caches

None.
